cards.data_structure: Panel or repeated cross-sections with treatment adoption at different times.
cards.identifying_variation: Within-unit changes relative to not-yet-treated or never-treated comparison groups, conditional on the design.
cards.estimand: Group-time ATT or another explicitly weighted dynamic effect, not an unlabeled TWFE coefficient.
assumptions: Design-specific parallel trends for the chosen comparison group
No anticipation for the stated pre-treatment window
Treatment timing and sample support are documented
diagnostics: Pre-treatment outcome trends as diagnostics, not proof
cannot_solve: A robust estimator cannot create parallel trends
An event-study plot cannot prove identification
Alternative weighting does not validate an unsupported estimand
reporting_requirements: Name the estimand and aggregation weights
Report support, anticipation window, and inference choices
cards.conservative_rewrite: The estimates are consistent with a treatment effect under the stated comparison-group and parallel-trends assumptions; pre-trend results are diagnostic rather than proof.

authority_sources.title: Estimating dynamic treatment effects in event studies with heterogeneous treatment effects

cards.data_structure: Panel or repeated cross-sections where treatment intensity varies rather than a binary adoption indicator.
cards.identifying_variation: Changes in treatment intensity relative to a design-specific counterfactual.
cards.estimand: A clearly defined dose-response or marginal effect over a stated support region.
assumptions: Common-trend or conditional common-trend restriction for the intensity contrast
Overlap across treatment-intensity values
Stable measurement and no anticipation
cannot_solve: A continuous regressor does not become exogenous by adding fixed effects
Linearity does not identify a causal dose response without design assumptions
reporting_requirements: Define the intensity unit and support
State whether effect is marginal, average, or local
cards.conservative_rewrite: The estimated dose-response is conditional on the stated overlap, trend, and functional-form assumptions.

authority_sources.title: Difference in Differences with a Continuous Treatment

cards.data_structure: Units combine predetermined shares with common shocks to form an instrument.
cards.identifying_variation: Variation induced by shares and shocks, with the source of exogeneity made explicit.
cards.estimand: A stated IV/LATE-type estimand for the compliant margin, if assumptions support it.
assumptions: Relevance
Exclusion restriction
Shock exogeneity or an appropriate shock-level design
No mechanical correlation from endogenous shares
diagnostics: Rotemberg or influence diagnostics where appropriate
cannot_solve: Calling an instrument Bartik does not establish exclusion
A strong first stage does not prove exogeneity
Controls cannot replace a shock-level argument
cards.conservative_rewrite: The IV estimate applies to the margin affected by the shift-share exposure and remains conditional on the stated shock and exclusion assumptions.

authority_sources.title: The Shift-Share Design: Theory and Applications

cards.data_structure: Experimental or quasi-experimental data with treatment-effect heterogeneity across covariates.
cards.identifying_variation: Treatment assignment or design-based variation within prespecified target populations.
cards.estimand: Conditional or subgroup treatment effect with a declared target population and loss/regularization rule.
assumptions: Valid treatment assignment for the target population
Honest sample splitting or prespecified model selection where claimed
Overlap and stable outcome measurement
cannot_solve: Machine learning prediction is not causal identification
Heterogeneous estimates do not prove a mechanism
High predictive fit does not validate subgroup causality
suitable_routes: honest causal forest or meta-learner with held-out validation
reporting_requirements: Declare target population and subgroup rule
cards.conservative_rewrite: The subgroup pattern is an estimated heterogeneous effect for the declared target population, subject to assignment, overlap, and model-selection assumptions.

authority_sources.title: Estimating Heterogeneous Treatment Effects with Machine Learning

cards.data_structure: Treatment, mediator, and outcome measured with a defensible temporal and counterfactual structure.
cards.identifying_variation: Treatment assignment plus mediator variation under sequential ignorability or a weaker descriptive decomposition.
cards.estimand: Natural/direct/indirect effect only when its counterfactual assumptions and scales are explicit.
assumptions: Temporal ordering
No unmeasured treatment-outcome and mediator-outcome confounding for causal claims
Well-defined intervention on the mediator
cannot_solve: A significant indirect path does not prove a causal mechanism
Baron–Kenny steps are not sufficient identification
Controls cannot automatically remove post-treatment bias
suitable_routes: causal mediation with explicit sensitivity analysis
reporting_requirements: Report direct, indirect, and total estimands separately
cards.conservative_rewrite: The mediator pattern is descriptively consistent with the proposed pathway; a causal mediation interpretation requires the stated sequential-ignorability assumptions.

authority_sources.title: A General Approach to Causal Mediation Analysis

cards.data_structure: Cross-sectional or panel outcomes with distributional or group-composition comparisons.
cards.identifying_variation: Conditional outcome distribution or between-group composition/reward differences under a chosen reference structure.
cards.estimand: A conditional quantile effect or descriptive explained/unexplained decomposition, not automatically a causal effect.
assumptions: Correct conditional quantile specification or decomposition reference
Common support
For causal language, a separate identification design
cannot_solve: A quantile coefficient is not a treatment effect by itself
The unexplained Oaxaca component is not automatically discrimination or causality
Distributional separation does not establish a mechanism
reporting_requirements: Use descriptive language unless identification is separately established
cards.conservative_rewrite: The estimates describe conditional distributional differences under the stated specification and reference structure; they are not by themselves causal effects.

authority_sources.title: Identification and Estimation of the Causal Effects of Treatments in Quantile Models

cards.data_structure: Sampled respondents, questionnaire items, response process, and a declared target population.
cards.identifying_variation: Sampling and measurement variation; causal variation only if assignment or design supports it.
cards.estimand: Population description, association, or randomized vignette/treatment effect as explicitly designed.
assumptions: Coverage and sampling frame are documented
Measurement validity and reliable response process
Nonresponse and weighting decisions are disclosed
cannot_solve: A representative-sounding sample does not prove causality
Reliability does not establish construct validity
Correlation in survey answers is not a mechanism
reporting_requirements: Report instrument, missingness, weights, and field dates
cards.conservative_rewrite: The survey estimates describe the responding sample and target-population adjustment under the stated sampling, measurement, and nonresponse assumptions.

cards.data_structure: Randomized assignment with treatment, outcome, compliance, attrition, and analysis population specified.
cards.identifying_variation: Random assignment (or a declared encouragement/complier design) within the study population.
cards.estimand: ITT or another declared treatment effect for the randomized population; LATE only with extra assumptions.
assumptions: Randomization integrity
Stable treatment and outcome measurement
Pre-specified handling of attrition and noncompliance
cannot_solve: Randomization does not guarantee external validity
Balance tests do not prove the randomization mechanism
A subgroup result is not automatically prespecified
reporting_requirements: Report attrition, compliance, exclusions, and multiplicity
cards.conservative_rewrite: Under the stated randomization and analysis-population assumptions, the estimate identifies the declared ITT effect for the study population.

cards.data_structure: Purposive or theoretical sample, recorded materials, coding process, and researcher positionality.
cards.identifying_variation: Meaning and process variation within the sampled cases, not statistical population variation unless separately justified.
cards.estimand: A bounded interpretive theme, mechanism process, or case-based explanation.
assumptions: Sampling and saturation/analytic sufficiency are documented
Coding and reflexivity are transparent
Negative cases and rival interpretations are considered
diagnostics: Inter-coder or peer debrief where appropriate
cannot_solve: A compelling narrative is not prevalence evidence
Theme frequency does not establish causal effect
One case cannot identify a universal law
reporting_requirements: Describe case selection and analytic steps
Bound claims to cases and evidence
Report positionality, negative cases, and transferability
cards.conservative_rewrite: The cases provide an interpretive account of the proposed process within the sampled setting; transfer beyond these cases requires additional evidence.

cards.data_structure: Two or more qualitative/quantitative strands with an explicit sequence, integration point, and meta-inference.
cards.identifying_variation: Each strand's own design-based variation plus a declared integration rule.
cards.estimand: A set of strand-specific estimands and a bounded integrated inference, not an automatic causal synthesis.
assumptions: Each strand meets its own quality threshold
Integration is planned and traceable
Contradictions are reported rather than averaged away
cannot_solve: Calling a study mixed methods does not repair weak identification
Convergence is not proof
Integration cannot erase contradictory evidence
cards.conservative_rewrite: The integrated inference is bounded by the quality and scope of both strands; convergence is treated as corroboration, not proof.

authority_sources.title: Best Practices for Mixed Methods Research in the Health Sciences
